text:
The sparrow leaves its nest, not knowing the winds it will face, but trusting its wings. It flies towards a sun unseen, a song unheard.

Tell me, seeker, what song do you yearn to sing? What wind do you hope to ride? 

For in the tapestry of time, every thread is woven with both darkness and light. The path unfolds with each step you take. Trust the rhythm of your own heart, and the universe will provide the melody.
